reuse.why: Routes every expected-amount site through the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the approximate tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast-schedules, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) in favour of the one helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; server, API and client only call it, and the API type extension lives in api-models.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps plus the API type and release notes; one release note still describes the superseded step 3 wording.

maintainability.why: One definition now governs the rule; a few display/filter callers in desktop-client still call it without the operator, so they silently skip the approximate rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All expected-amount computations call getScheduledAmount; remaining desktop-client display calls use it without op.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated midpoint logic was removed, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained an op parameter and an isapprox branch, which is the real variation of the rule; SchedulesTable, SchedulesListItem, MobileSchedulesPage and useScheduleEdit still call it without op (display/filter).
